title: Tool Permission Scopes for Agents
signature: def authorize_calls(user, agent, role_scopes, tools, resources, calls)
hints: Write one helper, grants(grant_list, scope), that understands exact scopes, 'prefix:*' and '*'. Everything else is built on it.

The effective permission is the intersection, so a scope is granted only when grants(user, s) and grants(agent, s) are both true. Don't intersect the literal strings: 'orders:*' and 'orders:read' share nothing as strings.
Run the checks in the order of the table and stop at the first failure. The tenant check comes before the owner/admin check, so admin never crosses tenants.
